tei:div.tei:p: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi cha lag: 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal ster bzhugs: na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye: dad dang mos gus ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin snying khong nas: sgo gsum dad pas gsol 'debs pa ni: e ma ho: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs: bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs: bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis 'bras bu mthar phyin nas: 'od gsal chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon gyur shog: longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga la gsol ba 'debs: bdag rgyud= bskyed rdzogs= 'od gsal= sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bdag rgyud= bskyed rdzogs= 'od gsal= mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs: bdag rgyud= bskyed rdzogs= 'od gsal= brgyud pa kun 'dus padma las 'brel la gsol ba 'debs: bdag rgyud= bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis= 'od gsal= dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus 'phags pa pad dkar 'chang: gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas: bskyed rdzogs= 'od gsal= theg dgu'i yi dam zhi dang 226)khro bo'i tshogs: gsol ba 'debs= bskyed rdzogs= 'od gsal= gnas yul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la: gsol ba= bskyed rdzogs= 'od gsal= gter srung dam can zhing skyong 'khor bcas la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis 'bras bu mthar phyin te: 'od gsal chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon gyur cing: tshe sgrub mthar phyin don gnyis 'grub par shog: de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthu byin gyis: phyi nang gzhan gsum dag rdzogs smin pa'i 'bras: sku gsum mnyam sbyor chen por grol ba dang: zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'thob shog: de ltar mi phyed dad pa yis: gsol 'debs 'di la brtson gyur na: sgo gsum smin cing grol ba dang: tshe 'dir don gnyis 'grub par nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya:
rgya rgya rgya: : ces pa 'di yang bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
